_readme: Round 4 tests the user's round-3 feedback: (1) intentional material — cloth vs leather tunic vs plate; (2) trousers fix; (3) helmets near-front turned ~15 degrees left, not side-on; (4) faction palettes — Unity earthy natural, Elaran black/dark gray + purple accents. Material, faction and slot rules all come from prompt-templates.json. Base SDXL (preferredCheckpoint).
